title: Feeding Two Birds or Favoring One? Adequacy–Fluency Tradeoffs in Evaluation and Meta-Evaluation of Machine Translation

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing machine translation evaluation metrics and meta-evaluation datasets by comparing their outputs against human-annotated Multidimensional Quality Metrics (MQM) split into adequacy and fluency categories. The bias is quantified using Pairwise Accuracy (PA), Soft Pairwise Accuracy (SPA), and F-statistics (to measure extrinsic dataset bias) to determine whether metrics and evaluation setups inherently favor adequacy over fluency.
